Module qilletni.api
Package dev.qilletni.api.music.orchestration

Interface TrackOrchestrator

public interface TrackOrchestrator
A class to handle the way tracks are selected. This should ideally take in a PlayActor to handle playing.

    • playWeights

      default void playWeights(WeightsType weightsType, CollectionLimit collectionLimit)
      Plays a set of weights directly. This must be a set of weights that add up to 100%, as it's not weighing an existing collection.

      collectionLimit - The limit of tracks to play

    • getTrackFromCollection

      @Deprecated(since="1.1.0", forRemoval=true) Track getTrackFromCollection(CollectionState collectionState)
      Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
      Use getTrackFromOrderableType(OrderableTypeState)
      Gets a single track from a collection state. If the collection is sequential, it will return the next unplayed track in the collection.
      Parameters:
      collectionState - The collection state to get the track from
      Returns:
      The track to play

    • getTrackFromOrderableType

      default Track getTrackFromOrderableType(OrderableTypeState orderableTypeState)
      Gets a single track from an orderable type state. If this is sequential, it will return the next unplayed track in the orderable type.
      The default implementation only supports a CollectionState, delegating to getTrackFromCollection(CollectionState).
      Parameters:
      orderableTypeState - The orderable type state to get the track from
      Returns:
      The track to play
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - If the implementation doesn't support the given state
      Since:
      1.1.0
